tasks.title: Mushrooms
tasks.instruction: Fill in the missing letters in the paragraph.
tasks.translation: 蘑菇由两个主要部分组成：菌丝体和子实体。菌丝体寿命很长，而子实体只有在适合繁殖的条件下（例如雨后）才会出现。菌丝体通常位于地下，由线状结构网络组成，可以从土壤中吸收养分。子实体位于地面以上，负责产生和传播孢子。这些孢子被释放到空气中以帮助蘑菇繁殖。

passage.t: Mushrooms are made up of two main parts: the mycelium and the fruiting body. The mycelium

of a network of thread-like structures that absorb nutrients from the soil. The fruiting body is above ground and responsible for producing and spreading spores. These spores are released into the air to help the mushroom reproduce.

layout.title: Rules and Regulations
layout.body:
Rules and Regulations
Welcome! Please follow these guidelines for a safe and enjoyable experience:
• Hours of Operation: Monday to Friday: 6:00 A.M. – 10:00 P.M. Saturday: 7:00 A.M. – 8:00 P.M. | Sunday: 8:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.
• Membership Requirements: Use a valid membership card to enter. Present your membership card at the front desk.
• Equipment Usage: Please wipe down equipment after use with the provided disinfectant wipes. Limit use of cardio machines to 30 minutes during peak hours. Return free weights to their designated racks after use.
• Locker Rooms: Lockers are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Please do not leave personal belongings overnight.
• Group Classes: Sign up for classes at the front desk or online. Arrive at least 5 minutes before the scheduled class time. Inform the instructor of any injuries or health concerns before the class begins.
• Safety and Etiquette: Follow all posted signs and instructions from staff. Report any damaged exercise equipment to the front desk immediately. Respect other members and staff at all times.
• Contact Information: For questions or assistance, please contact the front desk at 555-5678 or visit our website at www.GetBetter.com. Thank you for your cooperation and enjoy your workout!

tasks.title: Expert Systems
tasks.translation: 专家系统是人工智能的一个分支，旨在模仿人类专家的决策能力。这些系统利用专门信息和规则组成的知识库来解决特定问题，目标是复制医学和工程等领域专业人员的专长与推理。早期专家系统 MYCIN 于 1970 年代开发，用于诊断细菌感染并推荐抗生素。它使用医学专家提供的规则分析患者数据、推断诊断并建议治疗，表现常与人类专家相当；但系统需要不断更新，依赖大量专业人员输入。专家系统也有局限：依赖静态知识库，若没有人类专家持续输入就会过时，更新过程劳动强度大。机器学习与自然语言处理有望让系统从新数据中学习并自行适应。
paras: Expert systems are a branch of artificial intelligence designed to mimic the decision-making abilities of human experts. These systems use a knowledge base of specialized information and rules to solve specific problems. Their goal is to replicate the expertise and reasoning of professionals in fields like medicine and engineering.

An early expert system is MYCIN, developed in the 1970s to diagnose bacterial infections and recommend antibiotics. MYCIN used rules provided by medical experts to analyze patient data, infer diagnoses, and suggest treatments. MYCIN often performed as well as human specialists; however, MYCIN's system needed constant updates, requiring extensive input from medical professionals.

Despite their potential, expert systems have limitations; since they rely on static knowledge databases, they can become outdated without ongoing input from human experts. The process of updating the system can be labor-intensive. Advancements in machine learning and natural language processing could address these issues. By integrating these technologies, expert systems could learn from new data and adapt, improving accuracy and relevance. Researchers are optimistic that these advancements will transform expert systems, enabling them to tackle a wider range of challenges and operate more independently.
